LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.3: Reading Aloud
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud, part of Reading in Grade 4 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: Why is correct articulation important when reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. look at pictures of items and rooms found in the house in groups or pairs and read out their names (e.g. 厨房、客厅、卧室、桌 子、厕所、椅子、床、电视、冰箱),

2. read the paragraph and underline words and phrases of items and rooms found in the house collaboratively,

3. take turns to read out dialogues on the location of household items from a chart using 在、 上、下 (e.g.电视在哪儿? 电视在客厅。),

4. chant a poem on the importance of placing household items in their appropriate rooms with the correct pronunciation,

5. evaluate peers’ pronunciation as they read out dialogues on the location of items in the house.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. look at pictures of items and rooms found in the house in groups or pairs and read out their names (e.g. 厨房、客厅、卧室、桌 子、厕所、椅子、床、电视、冰箱),
2. read the paragraph and underline words and phrases of items and rooms found in the house collaboratively,
3. take turns to read out dialogues on the location of household items from a chart using 在、 上、下 (e.g.电视在哪儿? 电视在客厅。),
4. chant a poem on the importance of placing household items in their appropriate rooms with the correct pronunciation,
5. evaluate peers’ pronunciation as they read out dialogues on the location of items in the house.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: The learner is motivated to learn continuously as they seek and give feedback from their peers on how to

improve their pronunciation.

Values:
Respect: The learner is open-minded and displays humility as they receive feedback on ways to improve pronunciation from

their peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Healthy interpersonal relationships: The learner harmoniously relates with peers as they work together in reading activities, as

well as when they undertake the peer review.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to link their learning to Agriculture on the concept of household items and their appropriate placement.
